headline: Hawai'i Hilo's unbeaten run ends at UCCS
dek: Hawai'i Hilo went to UCCS with three wins and no defeat, and came home with their first loss and only the third goal they have conceded. No other programme has won as often, and none in the conference is now without a defeat.
displaced_by: Hawai'i Hilo lost at UCCS; the conference's last unbeaten side is gone

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Concordia Irvine's ten goals have come from nine different scorers, yet they have conceded eight and lost as many matches as they have won.

wire.line: No side in the conference is unbeaten any longer; Hawai'i Hilo's first defeat came at UCCS after three wins.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day; the Vanguard matches that do have a score have brought one draw and three defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chaminade have lost all three of their matches, scoring once and conceding six; the visit of UT Dallas was the third defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Pacific's six goals have come from six different scorers, yet they have conceded seven and lost two of their three matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Robert Ronco has scored both of Vanguard's two goals, from ten shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Strickler has made twenty saves for Westmont at a save percentage of .714.

last_match.line: Hawai'i Hilo's first defeat of the season, and their first result away from home against a side outside the conference.

next_match.line: Vanguard have yet to win; their visitors have already beaten Dominican (Calif.) and Jessup.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
